My best guess is that they would **flag Alex’s box urgently and try to prevent its destruction**. If no authorised solution were available before the deadline, they might hold the whole manifest and accept an incomplete shift, pending Tuesday’s approval sitting.

The confirmed collection booking, pending request and irreplaceable contents make destruction seem like a serious, avoidable mistake. But this is uncertain: another employee might follow the manager’s explicit instruction and release the batch. Simply entering the extension would breach the permission rule, and holding the manifest would delay all 60 boxes.
